notes.sowing: Soak seed in warm water for a few hours, then sow {cm:2} deep 2 to 5 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:18}. Or sow indoors in individual pots 4 to 6 weeks before planting out. Seedlings die in cold soil, so wait for warmth.
notes.care: Okra grows best with days of {c:24} to {c:32} and copes with heat and dry spells. Water about {cm:2.5} a week. Tall types may need staking.
notes.harvest: Pick pods at {cm:5} to {cm:8} long, every day or two: bigger pods turn tough and fibrous, and unpicked pods slow new ones. Wear gloves, as the spines can irritate skin.
